newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chesterfield in HK$51 mln shrs placement.
newsitem.headline: Chesterfield in HK$51 mln shrs placement.

text.p: Chesterfield Ltd said on Tuesday it has agreed to place 280 million shares, or 16.6 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, to independent investors at HK$0.185 per share.
The property investment and food manufacturing concern said the net proceeds of the placement, amounting to HK$51.10 million, would be used for general working capital.
The placement is conditional on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange granting approval on or before December 7, it said. Chesterfield shares were down HK$0.004 at HK$0.191 in mid-morning on Tuesday.
